delivery: canonical/legacy PDV provisioning isolation during transition
rootCause: Provisioning passed operationalSettings unconditionally, causing createSinglePdv to call ConfiguracaoPontoVenda.create even when activation was disabled and an older transaction client had no such delegate/table.
Internal ativarModuloOperacao supplied canonical settings without checking the activation boundary.
The legacy multipart adapter had stopped honoring its prior Trailer, first-PDV, default-tap, planned-operation and legacy response behavior.

solution.activationBoundary: Explicit CANONICAL or LEGACY mode is selected once by each canonical provisioning/API boundary and by internal module activation.
solution.canonical: Company, owner, one PDV and ConfiguracaoPontoVenda remain in the same transaction; CAIXA remains the sole canonical engine. Explicit capability settings are stored on the PDV; ConfiguracaoOperacional remains the owner of setup and compatibility metadata. No Trailer substitutes for a PDV.
solution.legacyCompatibility: Temporary transition bridge. JSON keeps its prior no-PDV creation and response contract. Multipart keeps explicitly selected Trailer/default taps, first PDV, legacy ConfiguracaoOperacao projection, enablement metadata and response contract. The disabled path never accesses the additive PDV configuration delegate.
solution.retirement: Remove LEGACY mode and old-client compatibility at the separately approved cutover after callers use the canonical API/schema, legacy consumers are reconciled and the cutover acceptance gates pass. This bridge is not a permanent second operating architecture.

focusedTests.unit: PASS; 52 tests for provisioning, activation guard, operational configuration/profile and mode authority.

preModelPostgresQa.schemaAndClient: pre-ConfiguracaoPontoVenda schema and generated Prisma Client; DMMF model absent; PostgreSQL table absent
paths: Legacy JSON provisionEstablishment: company/owner/config metadata committed, no default PDV or Trailer, old response resources retained.
Legacy multipart adapter: requested Trailer, first PDV, planned/taps/inventory/kitchen metadata, and ConfiguracaoOperacao projection retained.
ativarModuloOperacao with activation off: legacy config and first PDV created without the additive delegate.
preModelPostgresQa.baselineReproduction: Before the correction, the same pre-model client failed at tx.configuracaoPontoVenda.create and rolled back company/owner.

cases: Both admin provisioning endpoints under disabled and enabled activation; JSON and multipart response/resources/settings checked.
Legacy multipart created its selected Trailer, four default taps and first PDV; canonical multipart created one PDV/config and no Trailer substitute.
Legacy JSON preserved explicit plannedOperations/taps/inventory/kitchen metadata and its no-PDV contract.
Canonical provisioning retry/concurrency, single-PDV conflict, authorization, no-write refusal and intermediate rollback remained passing.
Disabled setup/edit reads and writes ConfiguracaoOperacional without implicitly rewriting the PDV; canonical setup/edit reads and writes the PDV and refuses EVENTO motor selection.
New canonical tenant configured catalog/menu, opened Por Caixa, sold, paid and closed with realization-session context.
Previously certified financial turns, legacy close before the additive session column, and commerce regressions passed.

focusedTests.testHarnessCorrection: An initial synthetic run exposed a test-only assertion using a nonexistent Prisma delegate name. The assertion was corrected to query the actual Tap model; the final synthetic and representative snapshot run both passed.

builds.frontend: PASS; npm run build; existing dynamic-import/chunk-size advisories only

representative.phases: Business/catalog/sessions/finance; kitchen preparation before commerce where applicable; commerce; finance revalidation and kitchen preparation revalidation after commerce; replay and reconciliation.
representative.approvedPayments: 605 IDs/values/classifications reconciled: A=26 exact sessions; B=2 receivables; C=577 null sessions with CAIXA_NAO_COMPROVADA. No duplicate, omission, timestamp attribution or inventory change.

compatibilityAndPendingConsumers.legacyBridge: Temporary until approved cutover; no shared legacy engine implementation was added.
compatibilityAndPendingConsumers.futureCutoverRemoval: After client migration and cutover approval, remove LEGACY provisioning mode, old JSON/multipart projections/resources and old-client support. Rehearse removal and all consumers before production execution.
pendingConsumerAudit: External scripts and direct database writers that bypass the HTTP/API locks.
Old JSON/multipart callers and deployed clients that still rely on the legacy creation response or resource projection.
compatibilityAndPendingConsumers.globalUniqueConstraint: BLOCKED until every legacy multiple-PDV tenant and dependent link is manually adjudicated and preserved, the disposition is rehearsed in QA, and the final set is proven zero-or-one PDV with valid canonical configuration; then add the constraint in a separately approved migration.
